---
title: "Merge Employment with AIIE panel"
date: "2026-04-26"
output: pdf_document
---

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Merge OES employment panel onto the AIIE / GenAI panel
library(tidyverse)


aiie_path <- "../Data/Intermediate data/generative_ai_aiie_panel_merge.csv"
oes_path  <- "../Data/Intermediate data/oes_panel_2016_2024.csv"
out_path  <- "../Data/Intermediate data/genAIIE with empl panel for K.csv"

# Read inputs (force naics to character to avoid type drift) 
aiie <- read_csv(aiie_path,
                 col_types = cols(naics = "c", naics4 = "c"))

oes <- read_csv(oes_path,
                col_types = cols(naics   = "c",
                                 tot_emp = "d",
                                 .default = "c"))


# 2. Aggregate OES detailed occupations to industry-year totals 
emp_yr <- oes %>%
  group_by(year, naics) %>%
  summarise(employment = sum(tot_emp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")


aiie   <- aiie   %>% mutate(year = as.integer(year))
emp_yr <- emp_yr %>% mutate(year = as.integer(year))

# 3. Merge employment onto AIIE panel 
panel <- aiie %>% left_join(emp_yr, by = c("year", "naics"))

# 4. Build the lag via self-merge on (naics, year - 1) 
lag_df <- emp_yr %>%
  mutate(year = year + 1L) %>%
  rename(employment_lag1 = employment)

panel <- panel %>%
  left_join(lag_df, by = c("year", "naics")) %>%
  mutate(
    employment_pct_chg = (employment - employment_lag1) / employment_lag1 * 100,
    log_employment     = if_else(!is.na(employment) & employment > 0,
                                 log(employment),
                                 NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  arrange(naics, year)

# 5. Save 
write_csv(panel, out_path)
message("Wrote: ", out_path, "  (", nrow(panel), " rows, ",
        ncol(panel), " columns)")

# 6. Sanity check (Logging, NAICS 113300, 2014-2022)
panel %>%
  filter(naics == "113300", year >= 2014) %>%
  select(year, naics, employment, employment_lag1,
         employment_pct_chg, log_employment) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# 7. Coverage by year
panel %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(n_emp = sum(!is.na(employment)),
            n_lag = sum(!is.na(employment_lag1))) %>%
  filter(year >= 2015) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```
